newsitem.title: CHINA: Price Waterhouse to boost China Everbright bank.
newsitem.headline: Price Waterhouse to boost China Everbright bank.

text.p: International accounting firm Price Waterhouse has been contracted by the Asian Development Bank to carry out a $600,000 capacity-building programme at China's Everbright Bank, company officials said on Tuesday.

The programme, to be carried out in association with Commerzbank AG, would bring international experience to Everbright's banking operations, said Thomas Macy, chairman of Price Waterhouse's China Financial Services Industry Practice.
The programme would cover areas such as credit management, internal auditing, accounting, computer systems, financial management, risk control and international banking, he said.
Everbright, China's first joint stock bank, is 51 percent owned by the China Everbright (Group) Corp.
